remarks: Fully renovated with brand new kitchen appliances, new flooring throughout and freshly painted throughout! This is a beautifully detailed description of a luxury condo located at 1 Strawberry Hill Avenue in Stamford. To summarize the key features: 9th floor of a premiere, luxury, 24-hour doorman building. 3 bedrooms, open concept floor plan, spacious living room, sunny dining area, and a private balcony with magnificent views. Updated with ample storage, perfect for serious home chefs. Generous en-suite with new luxury vinly flooring, large walk-in closet, and a marble full bath.Heated in-ground pool, grass courtyard, two gyms, library, refurbished hallways, pool deck, enhanced landscaping, and front entrance. Coveted 1 reserved garage parking spaces included. In the heart of downtown, walkable to restaurants, shopping, theatre's, and the train station. This condo combines luxury, convenience, and stunning views, making it a perfect choice and ready to move in and enjoy.
